item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 4 #VISPRSD
Issued at 05:21 PM 09 November 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Iloilo(Calinog, Lambunao), #Antique(LauaAn, Bugasong, Barbaza, Tibiao and Culasi) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Aklan(Madalag, Libacao), #Capiz(Jamindan and Tapaz) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
